resources.string: Lets the Claude sessions of your Harness server see this screen and use the phone for you: screenshots, taps, swipes, typing in a text field, the Back / Home / Recents keys, the list of on-screen elements and opening an app. Nothing else: no files, no shell. Use Pause in the notification to stop it at any time.
Permanent notification while the phone is linked to your Harness server, with a Pause button.
Paused: Claude cannot use this phone
Pair it with your Harness server so that Claude can use it when you ask.
This phone was removed from Harness. Pair it again to use it.
Claude can use this phone when you ask it to, within the rights set in Harness.
Every request from Harness is refused until you resume.
Linked, but Claude cannot see or touch the screen until the Harness Link accessibility service is turned on.
Turn on the Harness Link accessibility service so that the phone can be seen and used: Settings → Accessibility → Harness Link (sometimes under “Installed apps” or “Downloaded apps”).
If Android says the setting is restricted (app installed from the browser): open App info, tap ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings”, then come back.
Open the pairing link shown by Harness (Settings → Devices → Add a device → Android), or type the server address and the code.
The Claude sessions of this server will be able to see and use this phone once you accept it in Harness. Only pair with your own server.
This replaces the server this phone is paired with now.
Paired. Accept the phone in Harness to finish.
Wrong code. Create a new one in Harness.
This code has expired. Create a new one in Harness.
Name of this phone in Harness
The phone disconnects now and forgets its key. To remove it from the list in Harness too, use Remove in Settings → Devices.

Only what you ask for in a Harness session, and only what this app offers: take a screenshot, tap, long-press, swipe and scroll, type into the text field that has the focus, press Back / Home / Recents / Enter, read the list of elements on the screen, list your apps and open one.\n\nIt cannot read your files, run commands, install anything or see screens that apps protect (banking apps, passwords). It does nothing while the phone is locked. Pause in the notification refuses everything until you resume.
